text: The Practice Admin and the Practice Manager run the practice day to day. Here's what each sees, and the few things only the admin can do.
The one thing to remember: only the Practice Admin sets licenses, grants individual permissions and changes what a role can do. Neither can change their own access.

And like everyone, the manager can't change their own access.
The most common mistake is asking the manager to set a license or grant a permission. Those go to the Practice Admin, or for a license, the medical director.
